The [[Sienar Design Systems/Legends|Sienar Design Systems]] '''Star Courier''' was a small [[Transport/Legends|transport]] design with a limited production run.

==History==
[[File:Scimitar.jpg|thumb|left|200px|''Scimitar'' in space]]

The Star Courier was designed by the famed ship designer Rugess Nome, the public persona of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]]. Nome partnered with [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]], who would build the ships for him. One of these ships was the [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']],<ref name="DP" /> a modified vessel<ref name="TPM IC">''[[Star Wars: Episode I Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> that was designed for the Dark Lord of the Sith [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]. Upon its completion, [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]] delivered it to Plagueis's [[Damask fortress|fortress]] on [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]]. When Sojourn was [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|nuked]] by forces in league with the [[King/Legends|King]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]], Plagueis used the Scimitar to escape and rendezvous with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] [[Star Jewel/Legends|yacht]] while cloaked. Plagueis then passed it on to his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who in turn gave it to his apprentice, [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref name="DP" /> After the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine gave the vessel to the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Valin Draco]].<ref name="TGOA" />

Other vessels were in use by several [[darksider]]s over the years, with the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomiri]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Yansu Grjak]] using one during the Clone Wars.<ref name="JediAlliance">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance]]''</ref> 

The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]] also owned [[Garth Ezzar's Sith Infiltrator|one]] that was custom-made and resembled the ''Scimitar''. However, unlike that craft, it had no [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking]] technology. Ezzar used it in the [[Destruction of the Almas Academy]], when he attacked the [[Almas Academy]].<ref name="Destruction">{{LivingForce|Heart of Evil: Destruction}}</ref> He then flew it to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="AHSNV">{{LivingForce|Heart of Evil: A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance}}</ref><ref name="Destruction" /> 

Emperor Palpatine owned [[Palpatine's Sith Infiltrator|one]] during the [[Ghost Prison incident]].<ref name="GP2">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 2|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 2]]</ref>
